model: Raven Discovery with S+S couplers and Rohloff hub
description: Details: Large at the front, Large at the rear...This size is often favoured by Large pilots and taller than average stokers , this frame has double marathon tubing for strength and would suit cycle touring and camping, also happy to go on day rides. This Tandem comes with a three brakes an option which is recommended for a loaded touring and perfect for expedition tandeming. If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk. Please note that we no longer have an open showroom. Frame: L/L Thorn Raven Twin MK3 S&S Tandem Frame - Gunmetal Thorn Tandem twnin plate V Forks - Gunmetal Wheels: Shimano Deore HB-T610-L Front Hub - Black - 36 Hole Rohloff Speedhub 500/14 CC 14 Spd Gear Hub 36h Black with DISC fitting inc. 17T Sprocket & Tandem Axle Plate Ryde Andra 30 26"", 559 MTB Rims - Black - 36 Hole" Tyres - Schwalbe Marathon Mondial HS428 26 x 2.00 Reflex & presta tubes Transmission: Thorn 104/64 PCD Triple Crankset MK2 - Black - 175mm - front / 175mm - rear Shimano UN300 73mm Shell English Thread Sealed Cartridge Taper Bottom Brackets KMC X1 Rohloff compatible 1/2 inch x 3/32 inch chain. Thorn 104mm BCD 4 Arm Reversible Single Chainring 3/32 Inch - Black - 43T Brakes: [C1] Our recommended three brake option- Disc Rear, V Front & Rear. TRP Spyke mech disc brake. Shimano Deore BR-T610 V Brakes front and rear one operated via a Sunrace M90 Friction Thumbshifter left hand . Shimano Deore XT BL-T780 Trekking V Brake Levers - BLACK Hope Rohloff Specific Ventilated Floating 4 Bolt Rotor - 203 mm Jtek Cable Splitters for brake and Gear inner Wires - Black Finishing kit: Thorn eXp Flat Handlebars x 2 - 12.5 Deg - 31.8mm Clamp - 680mm - Black Ergon GP3 Handlebar Grips - Standard - Large - rear Ergon GP5-L Anatomic Grips - Large - Black - front SKS Chromoplastic Mudguards - 26 Inch - P55 - Black Thorn Ping bell Thorn Expedition Steel Rear Cycle Pannier Rack - Black Powdercoat Thorn Tandem Stoker Stem Extension Stems 17 Deg - Black - 170mm Velo Delux Sports Mens saddles x2 NOTE: NO PEDALS ARE SUPPLIED
